canonical_m1c_target.entry_price: open of the first five-minute bar after the checkpoint
canonical_m1c_target.name: movement_exceeds_prior_close_iv_15m
canonical_m1c_target.previous_close_implied_denominator: prior-close ATM IV * sqrt(15 / (252 * 390)) * sqrt(2 / pi)
canonical_m1c_target.terminal_price: close of the third five-minute bar after entry

direction_partition.AMBIGUOUS_BOTH_WITHIN_BAR: used only by the first-breach OHLC audit when both sides first breach in the same bar
direction_partition.DOWN_MOVE: signed endpoint log return <= -previous-close implied denominator
direction_partition.NO_MOVE: absolute signed endpoint log return < previous-close implied denominator
direction_partition.UP_MOVE: signed endpoint log return >= previous-close implied denominator
direction_partition.mismatch_reason: The frozen M1C event uses strict absolute_return > denominator, while the required direction partition assigns exact +/- denominator equality to a material direction.
